items.myth: The Great Wall of China is visible from space
items.fact: Astronauts say it is too narrow to spot from orbit with the eye

items.myth: There is no gravity on the space station
items.fact: Gravity is still strong up there; the crew falls freely with the station

items.myth: The far side of the Moon is always dark
items.fact: It gets as much sunlight as the near side; Earth just never sees it

scene.takeaway: Most space myths come from what we cannot see from down here
